Summarise a parametric bootstrap

Source: R/bootstrap.R
summary.RiskMap_bootstrap.Rd

Computes, for each parameter, the bootstrap median, bias, standard error and the percentile and bias-corrected intervals described in parametric_bootstrap().

Usage

# S3 method for class 'RiskMap_bootstrap'
summary(object, level = object$settings$level, ...)

Arguments

object

A RiskMap_bootstrap object from parametric_bootstrap().

level

Probability covered by the intervals. Defaults to the level of the bootstrap.

...

Not used, and an error if given, so that a misspelt argument is not ignored.

Value

An object of class summary.RiskMap_bootstrap, a list with the table of results (table), the level, the numbers of replicates and of failed refits (n_sim, n_failed) and the seed.
